conclusion: With the fixed parent absent on the current manual Host, these original launchers provide no authorized unchanged local provisioning route. Do not spoof GitHub context, provision the workstation through an alternate launcher, relax eligibility, skip the failing test, or rename its failure as a pass. Genuine hosted CI using its original source/job/Host owner is the supported automatic preparation route.
